To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“Medical Physics educators can use the CONET method to develop highly effective knowledge structures for medical imaging professionals and residents to improve image quality.”
medical physicists can use CONET to develop highly effective knowledge structures that will enable medical professionals to apply physics knowledge to clinical practice and improve image quality.
“Medical physics knowledge is most effectively learned and applied by medical imaging professionals when it is developed and taught in the form of a sensory concept network.”
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a method and supporting resources that will enable medical physics educators to teach medical professionals and trainees how to develop highly effective knowledge structures for applying physics to clinical imaging.
the development and use of effective knowledge structures by medical physics professionals and trainees to enhance their ability to apply physics knowledge to clinical imaging.
developing a model for medical physics knowledge and a method to develop effective medical physics knowledge structures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a new method and online resource for medical physics educators has been developed and implemented to provide medical physics educators with the tools and knowledge necessary to develop effective knowledge structures for medical imaging professionals and medical physics trainees.
the development and application of effective medical physics knowledge structures can contribute to improved medical image quality.

the method of using the synergism of the on-site medical physics teacher and the online resource CONET is an effective and efficient method of developing highly effective physics knowledge structures for medical imaging professionals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a method and online resource for medical physicists to use for developing effective knowledge structures for the large population of imaging professionals and trainee medical physicists.
medical physics educators and trainees can develop effective knowledge structures for clinical practice by using the synergistic combination on-site teaching and the online resource CONET.
medical physicists can be effective teachers and the knowledge they teach can be more effective.
The main takeaway from our work is that
medical physics educators have the ability to teach in a more powerful manner than has been possible in the past.
a synergistic combination of the on-site teacher and online resource is a powerful method to develop effective knowledge structures.
the development of effective conceptual knowledge structures is a synergistic process involving both the teacher and the learner and can be enhanced through the use of online resources.
